new mexico.dds_name: New Mexico Disability Determination Services (NMDDS), Division of Vocational Rehabilitation
new mexico.state_note: New Mexico's DDS is part of the New Mexico Division of Vocational Rehabilitation and has a single office in Albuquerque; New Mexico also pays a state supplement to SSI for people living in an adult residential or assisted living facility.

new york.dds_name: Division of Disability Determinations, New York State Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA)
new york.state_note: New York's disability determinations are made by OTDA's Division of Disability Determinations, and New York runs a State Supplement Program (SSP) that adds state money to the federal SSI payment.

north carolina.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services
north carolina.state_note: North Carolina's DDS is a division of the NC Department of Health and Human Services and, unlike most states, also makes medical determinations for state Medicaid disability claims.

north dakota.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, North Dakota Department of Health and Human Services
north dakota.state_note: North Dakota's DDS is a section of the state Department of Health and Human Services in Bismarck, and applications must be submitted through SSA, not directly to DDS.

ohio.dds_name: Division of Disability Determination (DDD), Opportunities for Ohioans with Disabilities (OOD)
ohio.state_note: Ohio's Division of Disability Determination is part of Opportunities for Ohioans with Disabilities, which is the sole state agency that administers SSDI and SSI disability determinations in Ohio.

oklahoma.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, Oklahoma Department of Rehabilitation Services
oklahoma.state_note: Oklahoma's DDS is a division of the Oklahoma Department of Rehabilitation Services and is fully funded by the Social Security Administration.

oregon.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, Oregon Department of Human Services
oregon.state_note: Oregon's DDS is a unit of the Oregon Department of Human Services with its single office in Salem, and Oregon adds a state supplement to SSI for some recipients.

pennsylvania.dds_name: Bureau of Disability Determination (BDD), Pennsylvania Department of Labor and Industry
pennsylvania.state_note: Pennsylvania's Bureau of Disability Determination is part of the Department of Labor and Industry, and Pennsylvania adds a small state supplement to SSI for some recipients, with an SSI approval also bringing Medicaid automatically.

rhode island.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, Rhode Island Office of Rehabilitation Services (Department of Human Services)
rhode island.state_note: Rhode Island's DDS is a unit within the Office of Rehabilitation Services, and Rhode Island pays extra state money to people receiving SSI in the state.

south carolina.dds_name: Disability Determination Services, South Carolina Vocational Rehabilitation Department
south carolina.state_note: South Carolina's DDS is a unit of the SC Vocational Rehabilitation Department with offices in West Columbia, Charleston, and Greenville, and it also processes Medicaid disability claims and disability retirement claims for the SC Public Employee Benefit Authority.
